name: Cabbage

schedule.notes: Compost or balanced fert when heads start to form.

harvest.cues: Head is firm to the squeeze and full-sized. If it splits, harvest immediately — heavy rain after dry spell is the usual culprit.
harvest.storageNotes: Whole heads with outer leaves keep 2 to 3 months at 32 to 40 F. Or ferment as kraut for indefinite storage.

varieties.name: Early Jersey Wakefield
varieties.notes: Conical heads, sweet, the first spring cabbage.

varieties.name: Savoy Vertus
varieties.notes: Crinkled leaves, tender, more cold-hardy than smooth types.

varieties.name: Brunswick
varieties.notes: Large drumhead, excellent storage and kraut variety.

notes: Watch for splitting: when heads firm up, cut roots on one side by twisting the plant a quarter turn to slow water uptake.
